theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (A S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (m : ℝ≥0∞) (x : Euclid P) (c κ R : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → 0 ≤ κ → 0 < R → m < ∞ → (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) y) ≤ 1) → (∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (x₀ : Euclid P) (ϱ : ℝ), 0 < ϱ → X.boundary = 0 → X.mass < ∞ → X.support ⊆ closedBall x₀ ϱ → |X ω| ≤ c * ϱ * X.mass.toReal) → S.boundary = A.boundary → A.mass ≤ m → S.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal κ * m → A.support ⊆ closedBall x R → S.support ⊆ closedBall x R → A ω ≤ (κ + c * R * (1 + κ)) * m.toReal
